title: Statistical Equilibrium and Entropy
research_question: When does the wealth-belief economy admit a justified stationary or maximum-entropy characterization?
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Do not assume an entropy maximizer is an economic equilibrium.
State conservation laws, invariant measures, ergodicity and detailed balance where used.
Allow non-equilibrium stationary states when detailed balance fails.
acceptance_tests: Explicit failure examples if assumptions break
deliverables: Validated stationary density and phase diagram

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
